Coverage_Description: China-trip protection with direct billing at designated hospitals; medical expenses up to HK$500,000/event (outpatient HK$200/day, 10 visits/year; Hong Kong follow-up within 3 months up to HK$50,000), personal accident HK$500,000, kidnapping death HK$100,000, personal liability HK$1,000,000, compassionate transfer HK$500, IDD
pricing: HK$680/year (annual premium); 10% first-year premium discount for existing PRUChoice Travel – Annual Cover customers.
customer requirement: Permanent Hong Kong resident with valid HKID and valid China Re-entry Permit/Card; normally resides in Hong Kong
additional informations: Renewable up to age 75; coverage per trip up to 120 days with unlimited trips in policy period; 15-day waiting period for Section 1 medical expenses (except accident)
